class Owner {public function run($n,$m,$f,$l) {} public static function good($n,$m,$f,$l) {}}
abstract class AbstractOwner {abstract public static function run($n,$m,$f,$l);}
function reject($raw) {try {set_error_handler($raw,512);}catch(TypeError $e) {echo $e->getMessage(),'|';}}

<?php
error_reporting(0);
class Owner {
    public static function handler(string $severity, $message, $file, $line) {
        echo 'H', func_num_args(), ':', $severity, ':', __CLASS__, '/', static::class;
        echo get_error_handler() === null ? 'Z' : 'BAD';
        throw new Error('pipe-handler');
    }
    public function emit($x) {
        echo __CLASS__, '/', static::class, ':', func_num_args(), ':', func_get_arg(0), '|';
        set_error_handler(['Owner', 'handler'], 8192);
        $restore = ini_restore(...);
        try {
            null |> $restore;
            echo 'BAD';
        } catch (Error $error) {
            echo $error->getMessage() === 'pipe-handler' ? 'T' : 'BAD';
        }
        restore_error_handler();
        echo '|', func_num_args(), ':', func_get_arg(0);
    }
}
class Child extends Owner {}
(new Child)->emit(x: 'x');
coverage: Current owned CONFIG PIPE null continuation with static public API handler and forwarded called class; genuine weak ARG4, saved emitter arguments and throw cleanup.
